numerical_reference: integer dot products of eighth-integer operands, scaled by repeated depth count, rounded once to FP16; exact FP32 conversion of those FP16 results
residency: two 2 KiB VTCM blocks reused along K and across transactions within one submission
percentile_method: nearest rank; small-sample p99 may equal the maximum
sample_order: seeded shuffled case/depth order per round; two checked warmup rounds excluded
session_policy: fresh Device/direct dispatcher and HMX power cycle per job; no cross-job operand residency

timing_scope.hmx: sum of four clear/depth-load/store windows; no packing, DDR copies or output conversion inside
timing_scope.input_copy: 4 KiB uncached job DDR to row-major VTCM
timing_scope.packing: 4 KiB in-place HVX row-pair shuffle in VTCM
timing_scope.raw_output_copy: four complete packed FP16 tiles copied VTCM to DDR, 8 KiB total
timing_scope.output_conversion: one last FP16 tile to row-major FP32 in VTCM, overwriting no-longer-needed inputs
timing_scope.fp32_output_copy: one converted 4 KiB tile copied VTCM to DDR
timing_scope.unattributed: remaining frame_job work, including validation, scales, metadata and loop/timer overhead
timing_scope.frame_job: SDK worker-0 c31:30 window; excludes entry scratch save/restore
timing_scope.publish_to_completion_ms: SDK elapsed_ms field: publication through observed completion and result extraction
timing_scope.submit_wall_ms: Device.submit including initial dispatcher installation, host copies, HMX power and acknowledgment; excludes session close
timing_scope.session_wall_ms: connection and full Device lifetime including direct dispatcher install/removal; excludes host numeric verification and post-session health audit
timing_scope.host_phase_ms: individual trace intervals; output extraction overlaps the SDK elapsed_ms scope, so do not sum indiscriminately

resident_slopes.method: least squares of median HMX ticks per transaction versus depth count
least squares of median HMX ticks per transaction versus depth count

interpretation: Correct synthetic resident-block throughput baseline, not distinct-weight model throughput. The approximately 7.4 GMAC/s load slope remains below the roughly 13.9 GMAC/s pointwise workload target.
